map.输入各部件重量与距云台轴的力臂（正值为镜头前方，负值为配重后方），计算合成重心与: Enter each component weight and its lever arm from the gimbal axis (positive toward the lens front, negative toward the counterweight rear) to compute the combined center of gravity and moment balance.
map.重心 x = Σ(Wᵢ·xᵢ) / ΣWᵢ；力矩 Mᵢ = Wᵢ·xᵢ: CG x = Σ(Wᵢ·xᵢ) / ΣWᵢ; moment Mᵢ = Wᵢ·xᵢ
map.基于力矩平衡原理，输入相机机身、镜头、配重、附件等部件重量与距云台轴的力臂，计算: Based on the moment-balance principle, enter the weights of camera body, lens, counterweight, accessories, etc. and their lever arms from the gimbal axis to compute the combined CG position and each component moment, with balancing advice.
map.💡 合成重心 CG = Σ(重量×力臂) ÷ Σ重量；当 CG=0 时力矩平衡。: 💡 Combined CG = Σ(weight×arm) ÷ Σweight; at CG=0 the moments balance. If CG>0 it is front-heavy (lens end) and needs rear counterweight.
map.力臂以云台旋转轴为原点，镜头/相机方向取正值，配重方向取负值: The arm origin is the gimbal rotation axis; lens / camera direction is positive, counterweight direction negative.
map.力臂取各部件自身重心到云台轴的距离: The arm is each component's own center-of-mass distance to the gimbal axis.
map.推荐配重为使 CG 归零所需的最小配重重量: The recommended counterweight is the minimum mass needed to bring CG to zero.
map.实际调平衡还需考虑俯仰/横滚/航向三轴，本工具为单轴简化模型: Real balancing also considers pitch / roll / yaw three axes; this tool is a single-axis simplified model.
map.📚 深度解析：云台相机重心与配平计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Gimbal Camera CG and Balancing
map.云台配平：输入各部件重量与力臂，算合成重心位置: Gimbal balancing: enter component weights and arms to compute the combined CG position.
map.稳定校核：重心偏离轴影响俯仰与配重: Stability check: CG offset from axis affects pitch and counterweight.
map.配重设计：按重心矩求平衡所需配重: Counterweight design: from the CG moment find the counterweight needed for balance.
map.算法：总重 = Σ重量；合力矩 = Σ(重量×力臂)；重心 = 合力矩/总重（m: Algorithm: total weight = Σweight; net moment = Σ(weight×arm); CG = net moment / total weight (mm, axis=0); balance counterweight = −net moment / counterweight-position arm (g).
map.例：机身 650g@20mm、镜头 500g@80mm、电池 300g@−120: Example: body 650g@20mm, lens 500g@80mm, battery 300g@−120mm, counterweight position −150mm → total 1450g, net moment 17000 g·mm, CG +11.72mm (front-heavy), needs 113.3g added at −150mm to balance.
map.重心为什么以轴为 0？: Why is the CG origin at the axis?
map.以云台俯仰轴为参考，正为镜头端偏重、负为后端偏重；偏离越大俯仰失衡越明显，须配平: The gimbal pitch axis is the reference; positive is lens-end heavy, negative is rear-end heavy; larger offset means more obvious pitch imbalance, requiring balancing.
map.配重位置力臂如何定？: How to set the counterweight-position arm?
map.为配重安装点到俯仰轴的水平距离；力臂越长所需配重越小，但受云台结构限制。: It is the horizontal distance from the counterweight mount to the pitch axis; a longer arm needs a smaller counterweight but is limited by gimbal structure.
map.关于「云台相机重心计算」: About the Gimbal Camera Center-of-Gravity Calculator
map.云台相机重心计算器基于力矩平衡原理，输入相机机身、镜头、配重、附件等部件的重量与: The gimbal camera CG calculator is based on the moment-balance principle. It takes the weights of camera body, lens, counterweight, accessories, etc. and their lever arms from the gimbal axis, computes the combined CG position and each component moment, and gives counterweight suggestions to achieve gimbal static balance.
